correctness.rationale: Deriving the 3x3 reduced dynamics from x+=W(x−αy), y+=Wy+H(x+−x) and the conserved tracker average gives the same cubic P(z) as the claimed reduced matrix. Exact Schur-Jury inequalities use P(1)=β(1−s)^2 and −P(−1)=2s(1−η²)β²−(s²+6s+1)β+2(1+s)^2. The proof establishes |c|<1 and J=1−b+ac−c²>0 before the smaller positive root; in the intermediate interval −P(−1)≤0, and beyond the larger root c<−1. Independent symbolic comparison with the true recurrence and sampled spectral radius on either side confirmed the formula. These tests do not certify all reals.
